title: Depression-TianTian
description: Extends the Depression mod with more polish, configurability, and a developer API.
body:
# Depression-TianTian

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e3847cd1744635df83525450164a0ff7f016734_0.webp)

## 📌 Dependencies

Requires Fabric API, Architectury API, and Depression as dependencies.

## 📑 Introduction

Depression-TianTian (hereinafter referred to as this mod) is a mod that extends the Depression mod (hereinafter referred to as the original mod).

It modifies part of the original mod's content, adds more configuration options, and can also serve as a library mod for other creators.

## 💖 For Players

One of the reasons this mod was born is that the author felt the original mod's diary content was too scarce and the writing felt too scripted.

For details, please refer to the in-depth introduction:

- **More hint messages**: Enhances immersion and novelty.
- **More prominent somatic symptoms**: For example, simulating anorexia by hiding the hunger bar.
- **More configuration options**: Such as disabling the mental trait selection screen, adjusting the psychologist's prices, and more.
- **Gameplay protection mechanisms**: Such as automatically preventing eye-closing when the player is airborne, safer catatonic stupor behavior, and more.
- **More ways to recover emotion and mental health values.**

Additionally, due to the slow pace of copywriting, the enhanced diary system has not yet been implemented in the release version as of the time of editing.

## 🗺️ For Other Developers

This mod is a library mod that makes the original mod's code more accessible, providing a rich set of events, semantic wrappers, and helper classes.

It also systematically refactors the original mod's diary system and hint message system, making it easier for developers to add or modify content.

## 💭 FAQ

Q: Other Minecraft versions?

A: No plans at the moment, but third-party ports are encouraged.

Q: Forge/neoForge/Quilt versions?

A: No plans at the moment, but third-party ports are encouraged. The more fundamental reason is that the original code quality is... hard to put into words.

## ℹ️ Other

The mod's name is inspired by a song: [TIAN TIAN](https://music.163.com/song?id=2707332868)
